description: Turns a prompt into a complete, playable browser game with sound, a lobby, online multiplayer and computer-controlled opponents.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. a Donkey Kong clone, a racing game, a space battle royale, or a zombie survival arena
ui.description: A complete browser game from your prompt, with sound, lobby rooms, online multiplayer and computer-controlled opponents.

sample_prompts: Build a multiplayer Donkey Kong clone with barrels, ladders, and platforming
Create a River Raid clone with scrolling river, enemy boats, and fuel pickups
Make a top-down multiplayer car racing game with power-ups and boost pads
Build a zombie survival arena where 4 players defend against waves
Create a multiplayer Pac-Man where one player controls the ghost
